'''Antonian Lagoon''' was a shallow part of the [[ocean]]s around [[Coronet City]] on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]] that lay between the [[Den of the White Worms|den]] of the criminal [[White Worms]] gang and the [[Coronet City Spaceport]]. In [[13 BBY]], the [[scrumrat]]s [[Han Solo|Han]] and [[Qi'ra]] fled from the White Worms on the [[Narro Sienar Boulevard]] across the lagoon in an [[M-68 landspeeder]] while pursued by the White Worm [[Moloch]] in a [[A-A4B truckspeeder]]. A near collision forced the [[landspeeder]] onto the [[Shug Drabor Causeway]] which led from the lagoon to the [[factory]] [[Coronet SFS-13]].

==Description==
[[File:AntonianLagoon-CLNE.png|thumb|right|350px|Antonian Lagoon lay between the Den of the White Worms and the Coronet City Spaceport.]]
Antonian Lagoon was a shallow body of [[water]] within the [[ocean]] around [[Coronet City]] on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]]. It lay between the pills housing the [[Coronet City Spaceport]] and the [[Den of the White Worms]]—which had previously been known as Syllain District Water Processing Plant Cresh—with the [[Narro Sienar Boulevard]] bridging the lagoon to directly connect the two in a straight line.<ref name="CLNE" />

The [[Kerred Santhe Causeway]] branched off from the boulevard over the lagoon to the [[spaceport]]'s [[Coronet Spaceport freight terminal|freight terminal]] and the [[Shug Drabor Causeway]] split off at the same point to the pill housing the factory [[Coronet SFS-13]]. Another branch of the boulevard crossed the lagoon to the [[Sienar Fleet Systems supply depot]] located on the same pill as the den. On the opposite side of that pill, a [[fishing]] pier extended into the lagoon.<ref name="CLNE" />

==History==
[[File:ChaseThruCoronet-SWBC56.png|left|thumb|300px|Han and Qi'ra fled from the White Worms across Antonian Lagoon.]]
By [[13 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events depicted on the [[Corellia]] page of ''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' to [[13 BBY]].</ref> the fishing pier had been abandoned and become a hang out for the [[scrumrat]]s of the criminal [[White Worms]] gang who inhabited the den. When fleeing from the White Worms<ref name="CLNE" /> that [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="Date" /> the scrumrats [[Han Solo|Han]] and [[Qi'ra]] crossed the lagoon from the den in a [[M-68 landspeeder]] using the boulevard, hoping to head straight to the spaceport. However, the White Worm enforcer [[Moloch]] pursed them from the supply depot branch in a [[A-A4B truckspeeder]] and caught up to them before reaching the junction onto the two causeways, where a near collision with a [[landspeeder]] and a [[speeder truck]] caused Han to divert down the Shug Drabor Causeway to Coronet SFS-13, with Moloch remaining in pursuit.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> While this chase occured, a [[OI-CT]] [[walker]] navigated its way across the lagoon toward the den.<ref name="CLNE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Antonian Lagoon first appeared in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> It was first identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'',<ref name="CLNE" /> the new material for which was written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Emily Shkoukani]].<ref name="Bluesky">{{Bluesky|jasoncfry.bsky.social|post/3ljusdhg5mc26|[[Jason Fry]]|date=2025-03-08|quote=Just got a copy of the newly revised Star Wars: Complete Locations from DK, out Tuesday! I wrote the updates with the peerless @shkouks.bsky.social. You'll find 12 new artworks, an updated galaxy map, new and reworked planet profiles, and details and Easter eggs galore. And a glorious cover!|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/CJuwQ|archivefile=File:JasonFry-CompleteLocationsNewEdition-Bluesky.png}} {{C|@shkouks.bsky.social confirmed to be [[Emily Shkoukani]] by {{Bluesky|tarkinstopshelf.bsky.social|post/3kjlh6aw5ry2k|[[Tarkin's Top Shelf]]|date=2024-01-22|quote=New Episode! #296: Dawn of Rebellion with @shkouks.bsky.social and @infinata.bsky.social! Your hosts welcome Emily Shkoukani and Pablo Hidalgo to the show! They discuss the creative process behind the Visual Guide and get to know their guests with some fun #StarWars questions!📚|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/eePoa|archivefile=File:TarkinsTopShelf-Shkoukani-Bluesky.png}}}}</ref>
